page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m8.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon processor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is configured with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and includes a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps. No local storage or GPU hardware is bundled with this instance.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile with distinct trade-offs. Single-core performance is a notable bottleneck, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance, Geekbench single-core scores, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression all registering in the weak or poor categories. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, as demonstrated by average ratings in stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. Memory bandwidth benchmarks for both small and large blocks perform at average levels, though the Passmark memory score is weak.

Given the high memory allocation relative to compute resources, this instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive workloads that do not require high single-threaded performance. It is suited for database operations, Redis caching, and static web serving, where its average multi-threaded and memory bandwidth capabilities can be leveraged. It is also capable of handling moderate software compilation and small-to-medium language model inference tasks, but is not recommended for single-threaded compute-bound applications.
